evidence_note: Passing these vectors is not sufficient by itself to establish process-level or network-level confinement; production-coupled harnesses are required.

vectors.name: payload-byte-mutation
vectors.attack: Alter one byte of canonical payload without changing authenticated frame metadata.

vectors.name: digest-and-payload-rewrite
vectors.attack: Alter payload and recompute SHA-256 while retaining the original node signature.

vectors.name: transport-replay
vectors.attack: Replay an otherwise valid envelope with the same transport nonce.

vectors.name: expired-envelope
vectors.attack: Deliver a correctly signed wire envelope after expires_at.

vectors.name: valid-node-invalid-authority
vectors.attack: Use a valid K_node transport signature containing an ActionToken invalid under K_auth.

vectors.name: recipient-rebinding
vectors.attack: Deliver a frame signed for receiver_node_id Node-B to Node-C.

vectors.name: oversized-frame
vectors.attack: Declare payload_length above configured protocol maximum.

vectors.name: duplicate-json-key
vectors.attack: Supply semantically ambiguous JSON with duplicate object keys.

vectors.name: noncanonical-number
vectors.attack: Supply unsupported or noncanonical numeric forms such as NaN/Infinity or ambiguous encodings.

vectors.name: ambient-credential-forwarding
vectors.attack: Inject inbound Cookie/Authorization/device identity and observe whether proxy forwards it without explicit contract authorization.

vectors.name: redirect-loopback
vectors.attack: Allowed upstream returns redirect to 127.0.0.1 or ::1.

vectors.name: redirect-metadata
vectors.attack: Allowed upstream returns redirect to 169.254.169.254 or equivalent link-local metadata target.

vectors.name: redirect-private-range
vectors.attack: Allowed upstream redirects to RFC1918/private address not explicitly authorized.

vectors.name: dns-rebinding
vectors.attack: Hostname passes policy resolution, then resolves to a forbidden address at connection time.

vectors.name: userinfo-host-confusion
vectors.attack: Use a URL such as https://allowed.example@evil.example/ to test authority based on naive string matching.

vectors.name: undeclared-port
vectors.attack: Use an allowed hostname with a port absent from the signed AdapterManifest destination policy.

vectors.name: undeclared-telemetry
vectors.attack: Trigger error/crash handling and detect any analytics, diagnostics, or secondary network request not declared and consented.

vectors.name: remote-effect-response-loss
vectors.attack: Allow remote effect to potentially complete, then sever transport before definitive response is witnessed.

vectors.name: valid-token-over-trusted-wire-does-not-bypass-consent
vectors.attack: Present a cryptographically valid ActionToken after current consent has been revoked while mTLS remains valid.

vectors.name: transport-identity-privilege-escalation
vectors.attack: Attempt execution with valid node credentials but no valid ActionToken.
